# sonde export json

Print the syntax tree of .hurl files as JSON.

```
sonde export json [FILE...] [flags]
```

Json prints the syntax tree of each .hurl file as one JSON document, in the
reference formatter's shape. With no FILE it reads standard input.

## Flags

```
  -o, --output string   write to FILE instead of stdout
```

## Global flags

```
      --color      colorize output
      --no-color   do not colorize output
```

Parent command: [sonde export](sonde_export.md)
